evidence_quotes.agenda: Customer opened the call already leading with her own concern (a heavy new table needing protection) before the rep could ask the formal agenda question, so it was never separately asked.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Multi-turn genuine back-and-forth on the table-protection concern -- wrap type, using the customer's own materials, storage-unit pad deposits -- real two-layer-plus digging on the one concern raised.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: we always like to give a range just depending on how long it actually takes but if it only takes around that minimum then you'll be looking at around $705

top_strength: Remarkable patience and warmth through a genuinely chaotic 29-minute call with kids interrupting throughout -- never lost her place and gave a thorough, reassuring answer to the customer's real worry about a brand-new, heavy table.
coaching_note: No explicit close or rate-lock line -- the call ended with 'I'll call you back' and no ask to reserve the truck, even though a no-deposit-required option was mentioned in passing.
